chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadala ibn Ayoub, from Nu'aym ibn al-Walid, from Yunus al-Kunasi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When you come to the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), go to the Euphrates and perform ghusl near his grave, and face him, and upon you should be tranquility and dignity until you enter the grave from the eastern side.

And say when you enter it: 'Peace be upon the Angels of Allah who have descended, peace be upon the Angels of Allah who follow, peace be upon the Angels of Allah who brand, peace be upon the Angels of Allah who are stationed in this sanctuary.'

So when you face the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), say: 'Peace be upon the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon the Trustworthy of Allah upon His Messengers and the decisive ones in His command, the Seal of what preceded and the Opener of what followed, and the Guardian over all of that, and peace be upon him and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.'

Then you say: 'O Allah, send blessings upon the Commander of the Faithful, Your servant and the brother of Your Messenger, whom You chose with Your knowledge and made a guide for whom You willed from Your creation, and the guide for whom You sent with Your messages, and the Judge of the Religion by Your justice and the separator of Your judgment among Your creation, and the Guardian over all of that, and peace be upon him and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.'

O Allah, send blessings upon al-Hasan ibn Ali, Your servant and the son of the one You chose with Your knowledge and made a guide for whom You willed from Your creation, and the guide for whom You sent with Your messages, and the Judge of the Religion by Your justice and the separator of Your judgment among Your creation, and the Guardian over all of that, and peace be upon him and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.'
Then you send blessings upon al-Husayn and the rest of the Imams (peace be upon them) as You sent blessings and peace upon al-Hasan (peace be upon him).

Then you come to the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) and say: 'Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful, may Allah bless you, O Abu Abdillah.'

I testify that you delivered from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, what you were commanded, and feared no one but Him, and strove in His path, and worshipped Him truthfully until the certainty (death) came to you.

I testify that you are the Word of Piety and the Door of Guidance and the Firmest Handle and the Proof upon those who remain and those under the earth. I testify that that preceded in what has passed, and that is a victory for you in what remains.
I testify that your souls and your essence are good, made good and purified, one of them from the other, by favor from Allah and mercy.

And I call Allah to witness and I make you witnesses that I am a believer in you and a follower of you in my own self, and the laws of my religion, and the completion of my deeds, and my return, and my dwelling.

And I ask Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful, to complete that for me. I testify that you delivered from Allah what He commanded you, and you feared no one but Him, and strove in His path, and worshipped Him until the certainty came to you.

May Allah curse the one who killed you, and may Allah curse the one who ordered it, and may Allah curse the one who received it from them and was pleased with it. I testify that those who violated your sanctity and spilled your blood are cursed upon the tongue of the Unlettered Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).
Then you say: 'O Allah, curse those who changed Your favor and opposed Your religion, and turned away from Your command, and accused Your Messenger, and prevented from Your path.'
O Allah, fill their graves with fire and their bellies with fire, and gather them and their followers to Hell, blue-eyed.
O Allah, curse them with a curse that every near Angel and every sent Prophet and every believing servant whose heart You tested for faith would curse them with.

O Allah, curse them in the depth of secrecy and in the open. O Allah, curse the chiefs of this nation, and curse its tyrants, and curse its Pharaohs, and curse the killers of the Commander of the Faithful, and curse the killers of al-Husayn.

And punish them with a punishment with which You do not punish anyone from the worlds. O Allah, make us among those who help him and by whom You are helped, and favor him with Your victory for Your religion in this world and the Hereafter.

Then sit by his head and say: 'May Allah bless you. I testify that you are the servant of Allah and His trustworthy one, you delivered as a sincere advisor, fulfilled the trust, were killed as a truthful one, and passed away upon certainty.'
You did not prefer blindness over guidance, nor incline from truth to falsehood. I testify that you established the salat, gave the zakat, enjoined the good, and forbade the evil.
And you followed the Messenger, recited the Book as its true recitation, and called to the way of your Lord with wisdom and goodly admonition. May Allah bless you and send peace with abundant peace.

And may Allah reward you, O truthful one, with good for your followers. And I testify that the jihad with you is a jihad, and that the truth is with you and to you, and you are its people and its source.

And the inheritance of prophethood is with you and with the People of your Household. May Allah bless you and send peace with abundant peace. I testify that you are the truthful one of Allah and His proof upon His creation.
And I testify that your call is true, and every caller other than you is false and refuted. And I testify that Allah is the Evident Truth.
Then you move to his feet, choose from supplications, and supplicate for yourself.
Then you move to the head of Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) and say: 'Peace of Allah and peace of His near Angels and His sent Prophets.'

O my Master and son of my Master, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you. May Allah bless you and the People of your Household and the offspring of your forefathers, the good and the righteous.
Whom Allah removed uncleanness from and purified with a purification.
Then you come to the graves of the martyrs and greet them and say: 'Peace be upon you, O Rabbaniyyun. You are forerunners for us and we are followers for you, and we are behind you and helpers.'
I testify that you are the helpers of Allah and the chiefs of the martyrs in this world and the Hereafter, for you are the helpers of Allah as Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said.

And how many a prophet [fought] and with him fought many religious scholars. But they never lost due to what afflicted them in the cause of Allah, nor did they weaken nor submit. And Allah loves the steadfast.
And you did not weaken nor submit until you met Allah upon the way of truth and the victory of the perfect word of Allah.
May Allah bless your souls and bodies and send peace with abundant peace. Glad tidings for the promise of Allah which has no change; indeed, He does not break the promise.
And Allah will bring you to the retribution of what He promised you. You are the chiefs of the martyrs in this world and the Hereafter. You are the forerunners, the emigrants, and the helpers.

I testify that you strove in the path of Allah and were killed upon the methodology of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and the son of the Messenger. May Allah bless him and his family and send peace with abundant peace.
Praise to Allah who made His promise true for you and showed you what you love.

Then you return to the grave and say: 'I have come to you, O beloved of the Messenger of Allah and son of his Messenger. And I am a knower of you, and a confirmer of your right, and a perceiver of your merit.'
And a knower of the deviation of those who opposed you, and a knower of the guidance upon which you are. May my father and mother and self be sacrificed for you.
O Allah, I send blessings upon him as You sent upon him, You and Your Messenger and the Commander of the Faithful. A continuous, connected, successive blessing, one following the other.
With no break, no limit, and no term, in our presence and when we are absent and present. And peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.
And when you wish to bid him farewell, say: 'Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. I entrust you to Allah and convey peace to you.'
We believed in Allah and the Messenger and what you brought and pointed to, and we followed the Messenger. So record us with the witnesses.
O Allah, do not make it the last covenant from us and from him. O Allah, I ask You to benefit us with his love.
O Allah, resurrect him in a praiseworthy station by which You help Your religion and kill Your enemy and destroy those who made war against the Family of Muhammad.
For You promised that and You do not break the promise. Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.
I testify that you are noble martyrs who strove in the path of Allah and were killed upon the methodology of the Messenger of Allah. May Allah bless him and his family and send abundant peace.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title for Imam Ali (AS).
key_terms.السَّكِينَة: Tranquility and composure, a required spiritual state during the visit.
key_terms.الْأَيْمَان: The Oaths, referring to the swearing of allegiance or testimony.
key_terms.الْحُجَّة: The Proof, a theological title for the Imams as divine representatives.
key_terms.الْعُرْوَةُ الْوُثْقَى: The Firmest Handle, a Quranic term used here to describe Imam al-Husayn.
key_terms.الْغُسْل: Ritual bath, performed near the grave as part of the purification process.
key_terms.الْفُرَات: The Euphrates River, a key geographical landmark for the Ziyarah ritual.
key_terms.مَقَاماً مَحْمُوداً: A praiseworthy station, referring to the expected resurrection or status of the Imam.

ai.seo_question: What is the step-by-step ritual for visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn (AS) according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes the canonical liturgy for Ziyarat al-Husayn, emphasizing the spiritual purification through ghusl at the Euphrates as a precursor to entering the sacred precinct. It structurally links the Imam to the Prophet and the broader lineage of Imams, affirming their role as the 'Hujjah' (proof) of God and the inheritors of prophethood, while invoking specific curses upon their enemies to reinforce the theological narrative of the Ahl al-Bayt's struggle. The text serves not merely as a visitation guide but as a doctrinal declaration of loyalty and eschatological hope for the eventual victory of the Imams.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Nuaym Bin Al Waleed, from Yunus Al Kunasy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whenever you go to the grave of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, so go to the Euphrates and wash by his<sup>asws</sup> grave and divert your attention towards him<sup>asws</sup>, and upon you should be the tranquillity and the dignity until you enter to go to the grave from the eastern side, and said, when you are entering, ‘The greetings be upon the descending Angels of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>!
The greetings be upon the replacement Angels of Allahazwj! The greetings be upon the Branding Angels of Allahazwj. The greetings be upon the Angels of Allahazwj who are stationed in this Harram!

So when you face the grave of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, so say, ‘The greetings be upon Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! The greetings be upon the trustworthy one of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> upon His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasools<sup>as</sup>, and the most determined one in His<sup>azwj</sup> Commands, and the final seal due to what preceded, and the opening of what is in the future, and the dominant one upon all of that. And the greetings be upon him<sup>saww</sup>, and Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and His<sup>azwj</sup> Blessings’.

Then you should be saying, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Send Blessings upon Amir Al Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, Your<sup>azwj</sup> servant, and brother<sup>asws</sup> of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup> whom You<sup>azwj</sup> Appointed with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge, and Made him<sup>saww</sup> as a gift to the ones whom You<sup>azwj</sup> so Desired from Your<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, and the pointer upon the ones whom You<sup>azwj</sup> Sent with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Messages, and the established of the Religion with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Justice, and a decider of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Judgements in between Your<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, and the dominant one upon all of that. And the greetings be upon him<sup>saww</sup>, and Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Blessings.
O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>!

Send Blessings upon Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup>, Your<sup>azwj</sup> servant, and son<sup>asws</sup> one whom You<sup>azwj</sup> Chose with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge, and Made him<sup>saww</sup> as a guide for the ones whom You<sup>azwj</sup> so Desired from Your<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, and the pointed upon the ones whom You<sup>azwj</sup> Sent with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Messages, and an establisher of the Religion with Your<sup>azwj</sup> justice, and a decider of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Judgements in between Your<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, and the dominant upon all of that.

And the greetings be upon him<sup>asws</sup> and the Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Blessings’.
Then you should send Blessings upon Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> and the rest of the Imams<sup>asws</sup> just as you sent upon Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>.

Then go to the grave of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, and you should be saying, ‘The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O son<sup>asws</sup> of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O son<sup>asws</sup> of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>! O Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>!

I hereby testify that you<sup>asws</sup> had delivered on behalf of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic what you<sup>asws</sup> had been Commanded with, and did not fear anyone apart from Him<sup>azwj</sup>; and you<sup>asws</sup> struggled in His<sup>azwj</sup> Way, and worshipped Him<sup>azwj</sup> truthfully until the conviction (death) came to you<sup>asws</sup>.

I testify that youasws are the [48:26] the word of piety, and the door of guidance, and the [31:22] the Firmest Handle, and the Proof upon the ones who remain, and the ones under the ground. I testify that preceded in what has past, and that is a victory for youasws regarding what remains.
I testify that your<sup>asws</sup> souls and your<sup>asws</sup> essences are good, Made good and Purified, and one of them was from the other, being a Favour from Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and a Mercy.

And I testify by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and keep you<sup>asws</sup> as witnesses that I am a believer in you<sup>asws</sup>, and a follower of yours<sup>asws</sup> with regards to my own person, and Laws of my Religion, and the completion of my deeds, and my transference, and my place of rest.

And I ask Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the Benefactor, the Merciful, that He<sup>azwj</sup> Completes that for me. I testify that you<sup>asws</sup> have preached on behalf of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> what you<sup>asws</sup> had been Commanded with, and never feared anyone apart from Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and you<sup>asws</sup> struggled in His<sup>azwj</sup> Way, and worshipped Him<sup>azwj</sup> until the conviction (death) came to you<sup>asws</sup> all.

And May Allahazwj Curse the ones who murdered youasws, and the one who ordered with it, and may Allahazwj Curse the ones who executed it from them, so he was pleased with it. I testify that those who violated yourasws sanctities and spilt yourasws blood are accursed upon the tongue of the Ummy Prophetsaww.

Then you should be saying, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Curse those who changed Your<sup>azwj</sup> Bounties and opposed Your<sup>azwj</sup> Religion, and turned away from Your<sup>azwj</sup> Commands, and falsely accused Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, and prevented from Your<sup>azwj</sup> Way.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Fill their graves with Fire, and their insides with Fire, and Resurrect them and their adherents to Hell as blue-eyed.
O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>!

Curse them with such a Curse that every Angel of Proximity would curse with, and every Musril Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, and every Believing servant whose heart has been Tested for the faith. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>!

Curse them in private, privately, and in the open, publicly. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Curse the false gods of this community, and Curse its tyrants, and Curse its Pharaohs, and Curse the murderer of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, and Curse the murderer of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, and Punish them with such a Punishment which no one has been Punished with from the worlds. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>!
Make us to be from the ones who help him<sup>asws</sup>, and are sought for help, and Favoured upon with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Help for Your<sup>azwj</sup> Religion, in the world and the Hereafter.

Then sit by his<sup>asws</sup> head, so say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup> May the Blessings of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> be upon you<sup>asws</sup>! I testify that you<sup>asws</sup> are a servant of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and His<sup>azwj</sup> trustworthy one.

You<sup>asws</sup> delivered the preaching, and fulfilled the entrustments, and were murdered while being truthful, and passed away upon conviction, never having had preferred the blindness over guidance, and did not incline away from Truth to the falsehood.

I testify that youasws have established the Salaat, and paid the Zakat, and enjoined with the goodness and forbade from the evil, and followed the Rasoolsaww, and recited the Book as its was its right to be recited, and called to the Way of yourasws Lordazwj with the wisdom and the goodly preachings. May Allahazwj Send Blessings upon youasws, and greetings with abundant greetings.

And may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Recompense you<sup>asws</sup> goodly from the truthful ones of your<sup>asws</sup> citizens. 
And I testify that the Jihad with you is a Jihad, and that the Truth is with you<sup>asws</sup>, and to you<sup>asws</sup>, and you<sup>asws</sup> are its rightful one, and its mine, and the inheritance of the Prophet-hood is with you<sup>asws</sup>, and with the People<sup>asws</sup> of your<sup>asws</sup> Household.

May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Send Blessings upon you<sup>asws</sup>, and greetings with abundant greetings. I testify that you<sup>asws</sup> are the truthful one of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and His<sup>azwj</sup> Proof upon His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures.

And I testify that you<sup>asws</sup> was true, and every caller linked to other than you<sup>asws</sup>, is on the falsehood, refuted. And I testify that Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, He<sup>azwj</sup> is the Evident Truth’.
Then transfer yourself to be by his<sup>asws</sup> feet, and choose from the supplications, and supplicate for yourself.

Then transfer to be by the head of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> and you should be saying, ‘Greeting of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and greetings of His<sup>azwj</sup> Angels of Proximity, and His<sup>azwj</sup> Mursil Prophets<sup>as</sup>, O my Master<sup>asws</sup>, and son<sup>asws</sup> of my Master<sup>asws</sup>, and Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and His<sup>azwj</sup> Blessings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, and upon the People<sup>asws</sup> of your<sup>asws</sup> Household, and the goodly offspring of your<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup>, the righteous ones from whom<sup>asws</sup> Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Kept Away the uncleanness from them<sup>asws</sup> and Purified them<sup>asws</sup> with a Purification’.

Then go to the graves of the martyrs and greet upon them, and you should be saying, ‘The greetings be upon you, O Rabbis. You all preceded us and we are following you, and we are behind you and are your helpers.

I testify that you are the helpers of Allahazwj, and chiefs of the martyrs in the world and the Hereafter, for you all helped Allahazwj just as Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Said [3:146] And how many a Prophet has fought with whom were many worshippers of the Lord; so they did not become weak-hearted on account of what befell them in Allah's Way, nor did they weaken, nor did they abase themselves – you were neither weak nor calmed down until you met Allahazwj upon the way of the Truth, and helped the Perfect Word of Allahazwj.

May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Bless your souls and your bodies, and Greet you with abundant greetings. Received glad tidings by the Promises of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, which there is no opposing it because He<sup>azwj</sup> does not break His<sup>azwj</sup> Promises.

And Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is Aware of you with the rest of what He<sup>azwj</sup> Promised you. You are the chiefs of the martyrs in the world and the Hereafter. You are the preceding ones, and the emigrants, and the helpers.

I testify that you have struggled in the Way of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and fought upon the manifesto of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and son<sup>asws</sup> of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and greetings (be upon you) with abundant greetings.
The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Made His<sup>azwj</sup> Promises come true and Showed you what you were longing for’.

Then return to the grave and you should be saying, ‘I come to you<sup>asws</sup>, of beloved of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and son<sup>asws</sup> of His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, and I am a recogniser of your<sup>asws</sup> right, acknowledger of your<sup>asws</sup> merits with an insight into the ones who opposed you<sup>asws</sup>, recognising the guidance which you<sup>asws</sup> are upon.
May my father and my mother and myself be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>!

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> to Send Blessings upon him<sup>asws</sup> just as You<sup>azwj</sup>, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, and Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> Sent Blessings consecutively, continuously, in tandem, one following the other, there being no interruption to it, nor a time, nor a term, in this presence of ours, and when we are absent and present, and the greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, and the Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Blessings’.
And when you want to bid farewell, so say, ‘The greetings be upon you, and the Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Blessings!

I entrust you<sup>asws</sup> to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and covey the greetings upon you<sup>asws</sup>, believing in Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, and in whatever you<sup>asws</sup> came with, and pointed upon, and made us to follow the Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, so we would be Recorded to be with the witnesses. 
O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>!

Do Make it to be the last of the promises from us and from him<sup>asws</sup>. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> that You Benefit us with his<sup>asws</sup> love. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>!

Resurrect him<sup>asws</sup> in the praiseworthy place, by which Your<sup>azwj</sup> Religion would be helped by, and by which Your<sup>azwj</sup> enemies be fought against, and by which the ones who establish war against the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> can be defeated, for You<sup>azwj</sup> Promised that and You<sup>azwj</sup> do not break the Promises.
The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, and Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and His<sup>azwj</sup> Blessings.
I testify that you are the martyrs who fought in the Way of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and were killed upon the manifesto of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and greetings be with abundant greetings’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Nu’aym ibn al-Walid from Yunus al-Kunasiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that when you decide to visit the gravesite of al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, go to al-Furat and take a bath near his gravesite; then move toward him in a serene and dignified manner until you enter the shrine from its east side.

During entering say, ‘I offer greeting of peace to the descending angels of Allah. I offer greeting of peace to the substituting angels of Allah. I offer greeting of peace to the marking angels of Allah. I offer greeting of peace to the angel of Allah who live in this sacred place.’

When you are in front of the gravesite of Al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, you should say, ‘(I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge the divine authority of and my) submission to (the commandments of) the Messenger of Allah. (I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge the divine authority of the trustee of Allah over His messengers and His decisive commandments, the seal of that which were before and the opening of that which is to come and the dominant over all of the affairs. May Allah grant him protection, kindness and blessings.’

Then you should say, £ 0 Allah, I appeal before You to grant salawat (favors and compensation) to ’Amir al- Mu’minin, Ali, Your servant, brother of Your messenger, whom You have chosen through Your knowledge and have made a guide for whomever of Your creatures You wanted and a vanguard for those whom You have sent with Your messages.

He is the one provider and facilitator of the system of justice of Your religion according to Your justice, a differentiator in the issuance of Your judgment among Your creatures and the dominant over all such affairs. O Allah, grant him protection, kindness and blessing. O Allah, I appeal before You to grant salawat (favors and compensation to al-Hassan ibn Ali, worthy of his services to Your cause). He is Your servant and the son of the one whom You have chosen through Your knowledge and have appointed a guide for whomever You wanted of Your creatures, a vanguard for those whom You have sent with Your messages. He is the one provider and facilitator of the system of justice of Your religion according to Your justice, a differentiator in the issuance of Your judgment among Your creatures and the dominant over all such affairs.

O Allah grant him protection, kindness and blessing.’ Then say salawat al-Salam for al-Husayn and all other ’A’immah, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, just as you said for (Imam) al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam. Thereafter go near the gravesite of al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and say, ‘(I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are a ‘Alayhi al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments) O grandson of the Messenger of Allah. (I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are a ‘Alayhi al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments) O son of ’Amir al-Mu’minin. I appeal before Allah to grant salawat (favors and compensation to you worthy of Your services to His cause) O abu ‘Abd Allah.

I testify that you completed the task Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, had commanded you to accomplish. You were not afraid of anyone other than Allah, strove hard for His cause, worshipped Him a true worshipping until the time of your martyrdom.

I testify that you are the words of piety, the gateway of guidance, the unbreakable safety ring, the authority of Allah over the living and those under the earth. I testify that such qualities existed with you in the past and they are means of victory and triumph in future.

I testify that your spirits and your clay (substance of your bodies) are clean, pure and cleansed. The substances of you (’A’immah) bodies were one from the other. It was a favor and great kindness for us from Allah.

I designate Allah as my witness and I designate you as my witness that I believe in your (divine authority), I am your follower in my soul, in the rules of my religion, in the consequences of my deeds, in my return and my place of rest.

I appeal before Allah, Honorable and Merciful to complete it for me. I testify that you accomplished all that Allah had commanded you to do and in so doing you were not afraid of anyone other than Allah. You strove hard for His cause, worshipped Him until the time of your death. I appeal before Allah to condemn those who murdered you, those who commanded your murderer and those condoned with the plan of your murderers.
I testify that the statements of the Holy Prophet condemned those who violated your sanctity and spilled your blood.’
“Thereafter say, ‘O Allah, condemn those who have misrepresented Your bounty, opposed Your institution, turned away from Your command, accused Your messenger and created obstacles in Your path.
O Allah, fill their graves with fire as well as their bellies and drive them and their followers to hell with their eyes turned blue.
O Allah, condemn them with such condemnation with which the prominent angels, every messenger-prophet and every believing person whose faith is tested for its strength will condemn.
O Allah, condemn them in most secrecy and concealment as well as openly in public manner. O Allah, condemn Jawabit (pi. of Jibt, devil) of this nation as well as its Tawaghit (pi.

of taghut, transgressors), condemn its Pharaohs, condemn the murderers of ’Amir al-Mu’minin, the murderers of al-Husayn and punish them with such punishment which no one in the world is punished with. O Allah, make us of those who support him, of those whom You use for support and You grant them Your support for the cause of Your religion in this world as well as in the next world.’

“Then sit down near his head and say, I appeal before Allah to grant salawat (favors and compensation to you worthy of Your services to His cause). I testify that you are a servant of Allah, His trustee who has accomplished with wisdom the task of trustworthiness, spoke as truthful person and passed away with certainty.
You did not accept blindness in place of guidance and never deviated from truth to falsehood.

I testify that you performed salat (prayer), paid zakat, commanded people to do good and forbade them from doing evil deeds, followed the Messenger, recited the book in the true way of recitation and called people to the path of your Lord with wisdom and good advice.

I appeal before Allah to grant salawat (favors and compensation to you worthy of Your services to His cause), with safety and protection. I appeal before Allah to reward you as with the reward of a truthful one’s good rewards for his services to his people. I testify that Jihad (striving for the cause of Allah) in your support is the true Jihad. I testify that truth is on your side, it belongs to you, you are of the people of truth, the source of truth and that the legacy of prophet-hood is with you and with the people of your family.

I appeal before Allah to grant salawat (favors and compensation to you worthy of Your services to His cause), with peace and protection. I testify that you are Allah’s truthful servant and His authority over his creatures.
I testify that your call is truthful call and every caller appointed beside you is false and invalid. I testify that Allah is the clear truth.’
“Thereafter you should go toward his feet and pray for yourself as you may choose.

‘Then you should go toward the head of Ali ibn al-Husayn and say, ‘I appeal before Allah to grant you His protection and peace and the greeting of peace of His prominent angels and prophets who were sent as messengers.

You are my master and the son of my master. I appeal before Allah to bless you with His kindness and blessings. I appeal before Allah to grant compensation and reward to you, your family and the offspring of your noble and chosen ancestors from whom Allah has decided to remove all rijs (all filthy matters) and purify in a through purification.’

“Thereafter you should go to the gravesites of the martyrs and offer them your greetings of peace and say, I appeal before Allah to grant you peace and protection, O believers in the Lord, you have proceeded and we follow you. We are your followers and supporters.

I testify that you are supporters of Allah, the masters of the martyrs in this world and in the next life. You are supporters of Allah as Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, has said, “There were many prophets on whose side people believing in the Lord were fighting.
They did not show any lack of responsibility even though they were hurt for the cause of Allah, nor showed any weakness or compromise with the enemy.”
[3:146] You indeed did not show any weakness or compromise with the enemy, until you went before Allah on the path of the truth, supporting the perfect words of Allah.

I appeal before Allah to grant favors and compensation to your spirits and bodies worthy of your services to His cause, with peace and protection. There is good news for you through the promise of Allah, which does not change, because He does not change His promises.

Allah will accomplish His granting what He has promised to you, the masters of the martyrs, in this world and in the next life. You are the first al-Muhajirun (immigrants (to Allah)) and al- Ansar (the helpers).

I testify that you did Jihad (strove hard) for the cause of Allah and you were murdered while protecting the institution of the Messenger of Allah and the son (the child) of the Messenger of Allah, I appeal before Allah to grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause) with peace and protection.
All praise belongs to Allah who made His promise with you to come true and showed you what you loved.’
“Then return to the gravesite and say, ‘I have come to you, O beloved of the Messenger of Allah, the son (child) of the Messenger of Allah. I am aware of your status and I acknowledge your rights.
I am aware of your merits and the straying of those who opposed you. I have knowledge of the guidance you follow.

I pray to Allah to keep my soul and the souls of my parents in service for your cause. O Allah, I appeal before You to grant salawat (favors and compensation to you worthy of Your services to His cause) just as You have granted favors and compensation worthy of his services to Your cause, and as Your messenger and ’Amir al-Mu’minin have appealed before You to grant compensation to him worthy of his services to Your cause. Grant him a continuous salat, connected, substituted one, following the other without break in time or point of time at this time and when we are here or not here. (I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are a ‘Alayhi al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments) and appeal before Allah to grant you protection, kindness and blessings’.

“When you decide to say farewell to him say, ’(I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are a ‘Alayhi al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments) and appeal before Allah to grant you protection and kindness and blessings. I leave you in the protection of Allah and offer you my greeting of peace.
We believe in Allah, the Messenger of Allah and in what you have brought and guided to. We have followed the messenger, so list us among the witnesses.
O Allah, do not make this the last chance for me to visit him and his seeing us. O Allah, I appeal before You to make us benefit from our love for him.

O Allah, raise him to the praiseworthy position whereby You support through him Your religion, eliminate Your enemies, destroy those who commence a war against the family of Muhammad, ‘Alayhi al-Salam; You have promised so and You do not change Your promise.
(I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are a ‘Alayhi al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments and I appeal before Allah to grant you protection, kindness and blessings.

I testify that you are noble martyrs who strove hard for the cause of Allah and were murdered while protecting the institution of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause) with protection and safety a great deal.’”
